rows.note: Use this for bodily matters or injuries, as opposed to mental ones.

example.english: You need to keep physical wounds clean.
example.traditional: 身體上嘅傷口要保持清潔。
example.jyutping: san1 tai2 soeng6 ge3 soeng1 hau2 jiu3 bou2 ci4 cing1 git3

rows.note: Use this for the material, perceptible world rather than thoughts or the mind.

example.english: This class helps children understand the physical world.
example.traditional: 呢個課程幫小朋友認識物質上嘅世界。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 bong1 siu2 pang4 jau5 jing6 sik1 mat6 zat1 soeng6 ge3 sai3 gaai3

rows.note: Use this for something tangible, especially a physical book or other object rather than a digital one.

example.english: I want to buy a physical book, not an electronic version.
example.traditional: 我想買本實體書，唔想買電子版。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bun2 sat6 tai2 syu1 m4 soeng2 maai5 din6 zi2 baan2

rows.note: Use this in scientific contexts for properties or effects relating to physics.

example.english: This device cannot run faster because of physical limitations.
example.traditional: 呢個裝置受物理上嘅限制，唔可以再快啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zong1 zi3 sau6 mat6 lei5 soeng6 ge3 haan6 zai3 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 faai3 di1
